mapper.select: SELECT FROM sources s WHERE ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT FROM sources s JOIN source_favorites f ON f.source_id = s.id WHERE f.workspace_key = #{workspace} AND f.favorited ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC

INSERT INTO source_favorites (workspace_key, source_id, favorited) SELECT #{workspace}, id, #{favorited} FROM sources WHERE id = #{id} ON CONFLICT (workspace_key, source_id) DO UPDATE SET favorited = EXCLUDED.favorited RETURNING favorited

SELECT , s.content, t.bvid, t.page, t.cid, t.video_title, t.part_title, t.track_source, v.id AS local_video_id, v.filename AS local_video_filename, lt.track_source AS local_track_source FROM sources s LEFT JOIN bilibili_subtitle_tracks t ON t.source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN local_video_subtitle_tracks lt ON lt.source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN local_videos v ON v.id = lt.video_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
INSERT INTO sources (title, kind, filename, content) VALUES (#{title}, #{kind}, #{filename,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content}) RETURNING id, title, kind, filename, created_at, content
